Dear Giuseppe,
I am writing you in regards of ticket
ID0464793
, opened for FW updates on the chargers at Tor Sapienza.
I checked the chargers, and on all of them the Hawkbit.conf file was missing. I added the file to each charger from AWS, and the rollout of the FW v8.0.5 (which was pending), started immediately.
All chargers have the FWv8.0.5 rolled out now. You can proceed with the FW updates at your earliest convenience.
